name: game-postmortem
description: > Runs a data-driven post-mortem for a shipped, canceled or major-phase project: git history, sprint and retro records, scope and quality trends, and what AI agents contributed and cost per milestone, ending in owned lessons archived to production/milestones/. Use for "post-mortem", "project review", "what did we learn". Not for a single sprint (use game-retrospective).
author: AlterLab-IEU
